name: All payment records

queries.param1:
SELECT td.name feeTypeCdName,pfc.fee_name feeName,
CASE WHEN pf.payer_obj_type='3333' THEN
(SELECT oo.name FROM building_owner oo JOIN building_owner_room_rel borr ON borr.owner_id=oo.owner_id AND borr.status_cd='0' WHERE borr.room_id=pf.payer_obj_id AND oo.status_cd='0' AND oo.owner_type_cd='1001' LIMIT 1)
WHEN pf.payer_obj_type='6666' THEN
(SELECT oo.name FROM building_owner oo JOIN owner_car oc ON oc.owner_id=oo.owner_id AND oc.status_cd='0' WHERE oc.car_id=pf.payer_obj_id AND oo.status_cd='0' AND oo.owner_type_cd='1001' LIMIT 1)
ELSE pf.payer_obj_id END payObjName,
pfd.detail_id detailId,pfd.cycles,pfd.prime_rate primeRate,pfd.receivable_amount receivableAmount,pfd.received_amount receivedAmount,uu.name userName,pf.fee_id feeId,DATE_FORMAT(pfd.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createTime FROM pay_fee pf
JOIN pay_fee_detail pfd ON pfd.fee_id=pf.fee_id AND pfd.status_cd='0'
JOIN pay_fee_config pfc ON pfc.config_id=pf.config_id AND pfc.status_cd='0'
LEFT JOIN t_dict td ON td.status_cd=pfc.fee_type_cd AND td.table_name='pay_fee_config' AND td.table_columns='fee_type_cd'
LEFT JOIN c_business cb ON cb.b_id=pfd.b_id
LEFT JOIN c_orders co ON co.o_id=cb.o_id
LEFT JOIN u_user uu ON uu.user_id=co.user_id
WHERE pf.status_cd='0'
AND pf.income_obj_id=#storeId# AND pfd.community_id=#communityId#
<if test="startTime !=null and startTime !=''">AND pfd.create_time >= #startTime#</if>
<if test="endTime !=null and endTime !=''">AND pfd.create_time <= #endTime#</if>
<if test="configId !=null and configId !=''">AND pf.config_id=#configId#</if>
<if test="userCode !=null and userCode !=''">AND co.user_id=#userCode#</if>
<if test="primeRate !=null and primeRate !=''">AND pfd.prime_rate=#primeRate#</if> ORDER BY pfd.create_time DESC,pfd.detail_id DESC LIMIT #page#,#row#
